titulo: Norse Atlantic Airways suspends all flights as it makes urgent funding plea
cuerpo: Norwegian airline says its finances are ‘critical’ and it will file for bankruptcy if it cannot secure short-term backing Business live – latest updates Norse Atlantic Airways has suspended all flights and said it will file for bankruptcy if it cannot secure short-term financing urgently. The Norwegian airline, which operates long-haul flights around the world including from London Gatwick and the US to Europe and Asia, announced it was on the brink on Thursday morning, a day after warning that its finances were “critical”.
